avis.titre: A holy grail for the spots you just can't leave alone!
avis.texte: All my homies with dermatillomania know that when cystic acne pops up, things can get bad real quick. With full transparency, in case this helps someone else, I have a lot of scarring from picking at my hormonal acne. The mighty patches help a lot, but there are times you just can't leave it alone and suddenly, you have a scabby, bloody mess on your face. This balm is your answer! It keeps the spots hydrated as they heal, meaning there will be less hard scabbing to pick at, and it heals much faster without scarring! The biggest breakthrough for me is that this balm also seems to minimize inflammation once applied, making the spot flatter and more difficult to mess with. I'm 26 now and have been struggling with this cycle of breakout, pop, pick, scab, pick, scar, repeat since I was 13 years old, and out of all the products I've tried and probably thousands of dollars I've spent trying to minimize the harm I'm capable of doing to my skin, this balm has genuinely been the most all-around helpful product I've used to minimize the time a pimple spends on my face, therefore minimizing the time I have to obsess over it. I can't recommend this stuff enough! Just keep in mind — this balm is a "POST-blemish cream," meaning that it won't prevent any cystic acne, it'll only help any spots that have already been popped.

My hormonal acne comes in waves. I KNOW I'm about to hit a time of clear skin, but my last breakout covers so much of my body.
